summary.en: Solar System SS-02 is human-approved and the rejected Motion Streak visualization has been removed. Deep Space Phase 4A–4E are deployed, production-verified, and frozen; Phase 4F CMB Full Sky is active.
summary.zh-TW: Solar System SS-02 已通過人工確認，遭否決的 Motion Streak 視覺化已移除。Deep Space Phase 4A–4E 已部署、通過 production 驗證並凍結；Phase 4F CMB 全天圖進行中。
summary.ja: Solar System SS-02 は人による確認済みで、不採用の Motion Streak 可視化は削除済みです。Deep Space Phase 4A–4E は配備・本番検証・凍結済みで、Phase 4F CMB 全天図は進行中です。
summary.ko: Solar System SS-02는 사람의 확인을 통과했으며 제외된 Motion Streak 시각화는 제거되었습니다. Deep Space Phase 4A–4E는 배포, 프로덕션 검증 및 동결되었고 Phase 4F CMB 전천 지도가 진행 중입니다.

changed: Orbit Precision — traceable orbit contracts and rendering for eight planets and eleven representative satellites
Pointer-Anchored Navigation — bounded wheel, trackpad, and mobile-pinch anchor behavior
Unified Object Cards — one evidence-aware model across deployed scales
Solar System SS-02A–G — human-approved production state
Nearby Stars astrometry — catalog release, reference epoch, display epoch, position mode, and 3D velocity completeness are now distinct
Milky Way Scientific Scale Anchor — human-accepted camera/visual hierarchy, grouped Object Cards, one Cosmic Time state, bounded differential rotation, catalog propagation, and production validation
Deep Space Phase 4A — 77 nearby galaxy groups and 456 canonical member identities from Kourkchi & Tully (2017)
Deep Space Phase 4B — 1,589 EVCC Virgo galaxies with M/P membership, actual sky coordinates, velocity provenance, and explicit representative radial placement
Deep Space Phase 4C — 2,387 measured-distance Cosmicflows-2 groups with radial peculiar-velocity context and no fabricated Laniakea boundary
Deep Space Phase 4D — catalog-observed SDSS galaxies, derived groups/density, reconstructed filaments/voids, explicit survey incompleteness, unavailable wall geometry, and continuous hierarchical LOD
Deep Space Phase 4E — observer-centered Planck18 radial scales and two sparse JADES catalog landmarks without all-sky fill or a CMB map
fixed: Earth-owned visitor and regional markers are suspended before entering Deep Space and guarded against late asynchronous refresh
Human-rejected Motion Streak / micro-glow visualization removed; normal point-star rendering restored
knownIssues: Foundation Release Audit remains open pending physical Mac trackpad and real-device pinch evidence
Titania lower-hemisphere imagery coverage / projection issue remains deferred
Deep Space Phase 4F is not yet completed
